initial_decision.brief_rationale: R296-3 establishes conditional exchangeability, consistency, no interference, and positivity. Standardizing stratum-specific risk differences over the population distribution of Z identifies the causal effect: (250/350)(0.4−0.6) + (100/350)(0.8−0.6) = −0.08571428571428572.
